panel.introduction: Varuna’s rapid rotation and changing brightness reveal an elongated world beyond Neptune. This smooth model follows a published light-curve fit; its absolute size remains approximate.

facts.label: Rotation
facts.value: About 6.34357 hours from photometry; display phase is illustrative

moreFacts.label: Shape interpretation
moreFacts.value: Illustrative scale model of the published Jacobi fit: b/a=0.60, c/b=0.72, scaled to the paper’s adopted approximate 700 km volume-equivalent diameter. These smooth axes are inferred, not resolved terrain.

controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Illustrative scale model of the published Jacobi fit: b/a=0.60, c/b=0.72, scaled to the paper’s adopted approximate 700 km volume-equivalent diameter. These smooth axes are inferred, not resolved terrain. Uses one published pole interpretation, ecliptic longitude 53° ±10° and latitude −64° ±6°, converted with the J2000 mean obliquity for display. The antipodal pole is also allowed; equinox and meridian are display conventions, not a qualified absolute attitude. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
controls.title: Published light-curve ellipsoid
